title: What parts do in a circuit
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Every part in a circuit has a job. A transistor controls the flow of current.
lines.label: controls current

lines.caption: A relay is a switch that is worked by electricity instead of a finger.
lines.label: an electric switch

lines.caption: A transformer changes wall power to a lower AC voltage.
lines.say: A transformer changes wall power to a lower A C voltage.
lines.label: lower AC voltage

lines.caption: A rectifier turns AC into varying DC. Then a regulator controls the amount of voltage.
lines.say: A rectifier turns A C into varying D C. Then a regulator controls the amount of voltage.
lines.label: AC to varying DC

lines.caption: An inductor and a capacitor together make a resonant circuit, tuned to one frequency.
lines.label: a tuned circuit

lines.caption: An LED is an indicator light, and a meter shows a value as a number.
lines.say: An L E D is an indicator light, and a meter shows a value as a number.
lines.label: light or number
